summary: Legacy VB6 banking application with critical security and maintainability risks. Modernization framework shows good architectural patterns but requires integration planning.

hotspots.reason: ADO 2.5 dependency creates SQL injection vulnerability and limits scalability
frmLogin form lacks modern security patterns and session management
Financial transaction forms (deposit/withdraw) lack audit trails and validation

risks.title: Legacy COM Dependency Lock-in
risks.description: Heavy reliance on VB6 COM components and ADO 2.5 creates modernization complexity and security vulnerabilities

risks.title: Missing Business Logic Documentation
risks.description: Critical banking business rules embedded in VB6 event handlers without documentation or tests

risks.title: Data Contract Preservation Risk
risks.description: Unknown database schema and data validation rules risk data integrity during modernization
